items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Now I had another fellow, a cousin of mine, he was an old age of a man, Amarjan they used to call him in French, Amarjan. He was a great violinist too.

ctx.x: Same name as the violin player.

Same name. He was a valto. Now I had another fellow, a cousin of mine, he was an old age of a man, Amarjan they used to call him in French, Amarjan. He was a great violinist too. Oh, he had loved violin. He could play violin.
Where did Bichet live when you were a boy?
